name: Tin
overview: Scripture references tin alongside other metals such as gold, silver, brass, iron, and lead, highlighting its role in ancient material culture and commerce, as seen in Numbers 31:22 and Ezekiel 27:12. In prophetic imagery, tin is associated with dross and impurities within a furnace, symbolizing the judgment and refining process God uses to purify His people, as illustrated in Ezekiel 22:18 and 22:20. These passages collectively portray tin as part of the raw materials subjected to God's refining fire, emphasizing His sovereign authority in purifying and disciplining Israel.
